nodes.summary: A body of revolution in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is given by real numbers $R_1, R_2$ and a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ that vanishes outside the interval $[-R_1, R_2]$, is infinitely differentiable on the open interval $(-R_1, R_2)$ and is concave on $[-R_1, R_2]$. The dimension $d$ is only a parameter; these data do not depend on it.
nodes.title: Body of revolution

nodes.summary: Let $d \ge 1$ and let a body of revolution in $\mathbb{R}^d$ be given by $R_1$, $R_2$ and $f$. Writing points of $\mathbb{R}^d$ as $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{d-1})$, its solid is the set of all $x$ with $x_0 \in [-R_1, R_2]$ and $x_1^2 + \dots + x_{d-1}^2 \le f(x_0)^2$.
nodes.title: Solid of revolution

nodes.summary: The center of mass of a set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is the average $\frac{1}{\operatorname{vol}(K)} \int_K x \, dx$, where $dx$ is Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{R}^d$. By convention it is $0$ when $\operatorname{vol}(K)$ is $0$ or infinite, or when $x \mapsto x$ is not integrable on $K$. For a compact convex body this is the usual center of mass.
nodes.title: Center of mass

nodes.summary: Let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, let $\xi \in \mathbb{R}^d$ be a unit vector and let $\delta \in \mathbb{R}$. A cutting hyperplane of $K$ in direction $\xi$ at level $\delta$ is a real number $t$, standing for the hyperplane $\{p \in \mathbb{R}^d : \xi \cdot p = t\}$, such that the volume of $K \cap \{p \in \mathbb{R}^d : \xi \cdot p \le t\}$ equals $\delta$. Here a set of infinite volume is assigned volume $0$.
nodes.title: Cutting hyperplane at a level

nodes.summary: Let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, let $\xi \in \mathbb{R}^d$ be a unit vector and let $\delta \in \mathbb{R}$. We say that $K$ floats in equilibrium in direction $\xi$ at level $\delta$ if, for every cutting hyperplane $\{p : \xi \cdot p = t\}$ of $K$ in direction $\xi$ at level $\delta$, the center of mass of $K$ minus the center of mass of $K \cap \{p : \xi \cdot p \le t\}$ is a real multiple of $\xi$ (possibly…
nodes.title: Floating in equilibrium in a direction

nodes.summary: A set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ floats in equilibrium in every orientation at level $\delta \in \mathbb{R}$ if it floats in equilibrium in direction $\xi$ at level $\delta$ for every unit vector $\xi \in \mathbb{R}^d$.
nodes.title: Floating in equilibrium in every orientation

nodes.summary: For a unit vector $\xi \in \mathbb{R}^d$ and $t \in \mathbb{R}$, the closed lower half-space is $H^-(\xi) = \{p \in \mathbb{R}^d : \xi \cdot p \le t\}$.
nodes.title: Lower half-space

nodes.summary: A set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is centrally symmetric if there is a point $p \in \mathbb{R}^d$ such that the translate $K - p = \{x - p : x \in K\}$ is origin-symmetric, that is, $K - p = -(K - p)$.
nodes.title: Centrally symmetric set

nodes.summary: A set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is origin-symmetric if $K = -K$, where $-K = \{-x : x \in K\}$.
nodes.title: Origin-symmetric set

nodes.summary: A set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is a strictly convex body if it is strictly convex (for distinct $x, y \in K$, every point of the open segment between $x$ and $y$ lies in the interior of $K$), compact, and has nonempty interior.
nodes.title: Strictly convex body

nodes.summary: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$, let $\xi$ be a unit vector in $\mathbb{R}^d$, let $\delta \in \mathbb{R}$, and let $H$ be a cutting hyperplane of $K$ in direction $\xi$ at level $\delta$, with translation $t$, so that $H^-(\xi) = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^d : \langle x, \xi \rangle \le t\}$. nodes.title: Direction of the line through the centers of mass

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the unit sphere $S^{d-1} = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^d : \|x\| = 1\}$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$, centered at the origin.
nodes.title: Unit sphere

nodes.summary: Let $d \ge 3$. There exists a body of revolution $K \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ that is a strictly convex body, is not centrally symmetric, and floats in equilibrium in every orientation at the level $\operatorname{vol}(K)/2$.
nodes.title: Ryabogin's negative answer to Ulam's floating body problem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
